title: Joshua 1:1
content: 1 Now it happened after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, that Yahweh spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun, the assistant of Moses, saying,

title: Joshua 1:2
content: 2 “Moses, my servant, is dead. And now, arise, cross over this Jordan, you and all of this people, to the land that I {am} giving to them, to the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 1:3
content: 3 Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon, I have given it to you, just as I spoke to Moses.

title: Joshua 1:4
content: 4 From the wilderness and this Lebanon and unto the Great River, the Euphrates River, all of the land of the Hittites, and unto the Great Sea, from the going of the sun, will be your territory.

title: Joshua 1:5
content: 5 No man will {be able to} stand to your face all of the days of your life. I will be with you just as I was with Moses. I will not abandon you and I will not leave you.

title: Joshua 1:6
content: 6 Be strong and be courageous, for you yourself will cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give to them.

title: Joshua 1:7
content: 7 Only be strong and be very courageous, to be careful to do according to all of the law that Moses, my servant, commanded you. Do not turn aside from it {to} the right or {to} the left, so that you may succeed in every {place} where you go.

title: Joshua 1:8
content: 8 This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you will be careful to do according to everything written in it. For then you will make your ways prosperous and then you will succeed.

title: Joshua 1:9
content: 9 Have I not commanded you? Be strong and be courageous! Do not be terrified and do not be dismayed, for Yahweh your God {is} with you in every {place} where you go.”

title: Joshua 1:10
content: 10 Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

title: Joshua 1:11
content: 11 “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, because within three days you are crossing over this Jordan to enter to possess the land that Yahweh your God is giving to you to possess it.’”

title: Joshua 1:12
content: 12 And to the Reubenite and to the Gadite and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh, Joshua spoke, saying,

title: Joshua 1:13
content: 13 “Remember the word that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God {is} giving rest to you, and he will give to you this land.’

title: Joshua 1:14
content: 14 Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave to you on the other side of the Jordan. But you yourselves, being armed, shall cross over to the face of your brothers, all of the warriors of valor, and you shall help them

title: Joshua 1:15
content: 15 until when Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as {to} you, and they possess, they too, the land that Yahweh your God {is} giving to them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and you shall possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave to you on the other side of the Jordan, {toward} the rising of the sun.”

title: Joshua 1:16
content: 16 And they answered Joshua, saying, “All of what you have commanded us, we will do, and to everywhere you send us, we will go.

title: Joshua 1:17
content: 17 As {with} all of what we listened to Moses, so we will listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God {be} with you, just as he {was} with Moses.

title: Joshua 1:18
content: 18 Every man who disobeys your mouth and will not hear your words according to all of what you command him shall be put to death. Only be strong and be courageous.”

title: Joshua 2:1
content: 1 And Joshua, the son of Nun, secretly sent from Shittim two men, spies, saying, “Go, see the land and Jericho.” And they went and entered the house of a woman, a prostitute, and her name {was} Rahab, and they stayed there.

title: Joshua 2:2
content: 2 And it was said to the king of Jericho, saying, “Behold, men have come here tonight from the sons of Israel to search out the land.”

title: Joshua 2:3
content: 3 Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men, the ones coming to you, who came to your house, because they have come to search out all of the land.”

title: Joshua 2:4
content: 4 But the woman had taken the two men and had hidden them. And she said, “Indeed, the men came to me, but I did not know from where they {were}.

title: Joshua 2:5
content: 5 And the gate was to shut at darkness, and the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue quickly after them, for you may overtake them.”

title: Joshua 2:6
content: 6 (Now she had brought them up to the roof and had hidden them in the stalks of flax arranged by her on the roof.)

title: Joshua 2:7
content: 7 So the men pursued after them {on} the road of the Jordan to the fords. And they shut the gate after when the pursuers had gone out after them.

title: Joshua 2:8
content: 8 Now before they lay down, she went up to them on the roof.

title: Joshua 2:9
content: 9 And she said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given the land to you and that the dread of you has fallen on us and that all the dwellers of the land have melted from your faces.

title: Joshua 2:10
content: 10 For we have heard that Yahweh dried up the water of the Sea of Reeds from your faces in your going out from Egypt, and what you did to two of the kings of the Amorite who {were} on the other side of the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, that you devoted them.

title: Joshua 2:11
content: 11 And we have heard, and our heart has melted, and the spirit in a man no longer stands from your faces. For Yahweh your God, he {is} God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

title: Joshua 2:12
content: 12 And now, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I am doing kindness with you, that you yourselves will also do kindness with the house of my father, and give to me a sign of truth,

title: Joshua 2:13
content: 13 that you will keep alive my father and my mother and my brothers and my sisters and all who {are} to them and you will deliver our lives from death.”

title: Joshua 2:14
content: 14 And the men said to her, “Our lives in place of yours to die! If you do not tell this matter of ours, then it will happen, in Yahweh’s giving the land to us, that we will do kindness and faithfulness with you.”

title: Joshua 2:15
content: 15 Then she lowered them down by a rope through the window (for her house {was} in the side of the wall, so she was dwelling in the wall).

title: Joshua 2:16
content: 16 And she said to them, “Go to the hill country, lest the pursuers meet you. And hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned. And afterwards you may go your way.”

title: Joshua 2:17
content: 17 And the men said to her, “We {will be} innocent from this oath of yours that you have made us swear:

title: Joshua 2:18
content: 18 Behold us, coming into the land! You shall tie this cord of thread of scarlet in the window through which you lower us down, and your father and your mother and your brothers and all of the house of your father, you shall gather to you at the house.

title: Joshua 2:19
content: 19 And it will be, anyone who goes out from the doors of your house to the outside, his blood {will be} on his head and we {will be} innocent. But anyone who is with you in the house, his blood {will be} on our head if a hand shall be on him.

title: Joshua 2:20
content: 20 But if you tell this matter of ours, then we will be innocent from your oath that you have made us swear.”

title: Joshua 2:21
content: 21 And she said, “According to your words, so {be} it.” And she sent them away, and they went. And she tied the cord of scarlet in the window.

title: Joshua 2:22
content: 22 And they went and came to the hill country, and they stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. And the pursuers searched along all of the road, but they did not find them.

title: Joshua 2:23
content: 23 And the two men returned and descended from the hill country and crossed over and came to Joshua, the son of Nun, and they recounted to him all of the things having found them.

title: Joshua 2:24
content: 24 And they said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has given all of the land into our hand, for indeed, all of the dwellers of the land are melting from our faces.”

title: Joshua 3:1
content: 1 And Joshua rose early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim. And they came unto the Jordan, he and all of the sons of Israel, and they lodged there before they crossed over.

title: Joshua 3:2
content: 2 And it happened at the end of three days, that the officers passed through the midst of the camp.

title: Joshua 3:3
content: 3 And they commanded the people, saying, “As you see the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh your God and the priests, the Levites, carrying it, then you yourselves shall set out from your place and go after it—

title: Joshua 3:4
content: 4 but a distance shall be between you and between it, about 2, 000 cubits in measurement; do not come near to it—so that you will know the way in which you should go, since you have not passed over by the way from yesterday {or} the third day.”

title: Joshua 3:5
content: 5 And Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders in your midst.”

title: Joshua 3:6
content: 6 And Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Lift up the Box of the Covenant and cross over to the face of the people.” And they lifted up the Box of the Covenant and went to the face of the people.

title: Joshua 3:7
content: 7 And Yahweh said to Joshua, “This day I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all of Israel, who will know that just as I was with Moses, I am with you.

title: Joshua 3:8
content: 8 And you, you shall command the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Covenant, saying, ‘As you come unto the edge of the waters of the Jordan, in the Jordan you shall stand.’”

title: Joshua 3:9
content: 9 And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “Approach here and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

title: Joshua 3:10
content: 10 And Joshua said, “By this you will know that the living God {is} in your midst and dispossessing, he will dispossess from your face the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Jebusite.

title: Joshua 3:11
content: 11 Behold, the Box of the Covenant of the Lord of all of the earth crossing over to your faces in the Jordan.

title: Joshua 3:12
content: 12 And now, take for yourselves 12 men from the tribes of Israel, one man, one man to a tribe.

title: Joshua 3:13
content: 13 And it will happen as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests, the carriers of the Box of Yahweh, the Lord of all of the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, the waters coming down from above. And they will stand, one heap.”

title: Joshua 3:14
content: 14 And it happened, when the people set out from their tents to cross over the Jordan, that the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Covenant, were to the face of the people.

title: Joshua 3:15
content: 15 And as the carriers of the Box came unto the Jordan then the feet of the priests, the carriers of the Box, were dipped into the edge of the water. (Now the Jordan was full over all of its banks all of the days of the harvest.)

title: Joshua 3:16
content: 16 Then the waters coming down from above stood {still}. They rose up, one heap, at a great distance away, at Adam, the city that {is} beside Zarethan, and those going down to the sea of Arabah, the Sea of Salt, were completely cut off. (Now the people crossed over opposite Jericho.)

title: Joshua 3:17
content: 17 So the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh, stood firmly on dry ground in the midst of the Jordan. And all of Israel {was} crossing over on dry ground until when all of the nation had finished crossing over the Jordan.

title: Joshua 4:1
content: 1 And it happened, when all of the nation had finished crossing over the Jordan, that Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 4:2
content: 2 “Take 12 men for yourselves from the people, one man, one man from a tribe,

title: Joshua 4:3
content: 3 and command them, saying: ‘Lift up for yourselves from here, from the midst of the Jordan, from the firm standing place of the feet of the priests, 12 stones. And you shall bring them over with you and you shall leave them in the lodging place in which you will lodge tonight.’”

title: Joshua 4:4
content: 4 So Joshua called to the 12 men whom he had appointed from the sons of Israel, one man, one man from a tribe.

title: Joshua 4:5
content: 5 And Joshua said to them, “Cross over to the face of the Box of Yahweh your God into the midst of the Jordan. And lift up for yourselves, a man one stone, upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,

title: Joshua 4:6
content: 6 so that this will be a sign in your midst. When your sons ask tomorrow, saying, ‘What {are} these stones to you?’

title: Joshua 4:7
content: 7 then you shall say to them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off from the face of the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh. In its crossing over in the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off.’ And these stones will be for a memorial to the sons of Israel forever.”

title: Joshua 4:8
content: 8 And the sons of Israel did so, just as Joshua commanded. And they lifted up 12 stones from the midst of the Jordan, just as Yahweh had said to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel. And they brought them over with them to the lodging place and they left them there.

title: Joshua 4:9
content: 9 And Joshua set up 12 stones in the midst of the Jordan, under the standing place of the feet of the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Covenant. And they are there to this day.

title: Joshua 4:10
content: 10 And the priests, the carriers of the Box, stood in the midst of the Jordan until the finishing of all of the thing that Yahweh had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all of what Moses had commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and crossed over.

title: Joshua 4:11
content: 11 And it happened, when all of the people had finished crossing over, that the Box of Yahweh and the priests crossed over to the face of the people.

title: Joshua 4:12
content: 12 And the sons of Reuben, and the sons of Gad, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed to the face of the sons of Israel, just as Moses had spoken to them.

title: Joshua 4:13
content: 13 About 40, 000 equipped {ones} of the army crossed over to the face of Yahweh to the plains of Jericho for battle.

title: Joshua 4:14
content: 14 On that day Yahweh made Joshua great in the eyes of all of Israel, and they feared him just as they had feared Moses all of the days of his life.

title: Joshua 4:15
content: 15 And Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

title: Joshua 4:16
content: 16 “Command the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Testimony, and they shall come up from the Jordan.”

title: Joshua 4:17
content: 17 And Joshua commanded the priests, saying, “Come up from the Jordan.”

title: Joshua 4:18
content: 18 And it happened that when the priests, the carriers of the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh, came up from the midst of the Jordan, {when} the soles of the feet of the priests were lifted up to dry ground, then the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and went over all of its banks, as yesterday and the third day.

title: Joshua 4:19
content: 19 Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth {day} of the first month. And they camped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

title: Joshua 4:20
content: 20 And those 12 stones that they had taken from the Jordan, Joshua set up at Gilgal.

title: Joshua 4:21
content: 21 And he spoke to the sons of Israel, saying, “When your sons ask their fathers tomorrow, saying, ‘What are these stones?’

title: Joshua 4:22
content: 22 then you shall cause your sons to know, saying, ‘Israel crossed over this Jordan on dry ground.’

title: Joshua 4:23
content: 23 For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from your faces until you crossed over, just as Yahweh your God did to the Sea of Reeds, which he dried up before us until we had crossed over,

title: Joshua 4:24
content: 24 so that all of the peoples of the earth may know the hand of Yahweh, that it is mighty, so that you will fear Yahweh your God all of the days.”

title: Joshua 5:1
content: 1 And it happened that when all of the kings of the Amorite who {were} on the other side of the Jordan, toward the sea, and all of the kings of the Canaanite who {were} beside the sea heard that Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from the face of the sons of Israel until they had crossed over, then their heart melted, and a spirit was no longer in them from the face of the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 5:2
content: 2 At that time Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make for yourself knives of flint and again, circumcise the sons of Israel a second time.”

title: Joshua 5:3
content: 3 So Joshua made for himself knives of flint. And he circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath Haaraloth.

title: Joshua 5:4
content: 4 And this {is} the reason that Joshua circumcised {them}: All of the people having come out from Egypt, the males, all of the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the way, in their coming out from Egypt.

title: Joshua 5:5
content: 5 For all of the people having come out were circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness on the way in their coming out from Egypt they did not circumcise.

title: Joshua 5:6
content: 6 For the sons of Israel had walked in the wilderness 40 years, until the finishing of all of the nation of the men of war having come out from Egypt, because they had not listened to the voice of Yahweh, to whom Yahweh had sworn not to let them see the land that Yahweh had sworn to their fathers to give to us, a land flowing {with} milk and honey.

title: Joshua 5:7
content: 7 And he raised up their sons instead of them; Joshua circumcised them. For they were uncircumcised because they had not circumcised them on the way.

title: Joshua 5:8
content: 8 And it happened when all of the nation had finished being circumcised, that they stayed in their places in the camp until their recovering.

title: Joshua 5:9
content: 9 And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the disgrace of Egypt from upon you.” So one calls the name of that place Gilgal to this day.

title: Joshua 5:10
content: 10 And the sons of Israel camped at Gilgal, and they performed the Passover on day 14 of the month, in the evening, on the plains of Jericho.

title: Joshua 5:11
content: 11 And they ate from the produce of the land, from the morrow of the Passover, unleavened cakes and roasted {grain}, on that same day.

title: Joshua 5:12
content: 12 And the manna stopped from the morrow of their eating from the yield of the land, and manna was no longer for the sons of Israel. And they ate from the produce of the land of Canaan in that year.

title: Joshua 5:13
content: 13 And it happened, in Joshua being by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man {was} standing in front of him and his drawn sword {was} in his hand. And Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us or for our enemies?”

title: Joshua 5:14
content: 14 And he said, “No, but I myself have now come {as} the commander of the army of Yahweh.” And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and bowed down. And he said to him, “What {is} my lord speaking to his servant?”

title: Joshua 5:15
content: 15 And the commander of the army of Yahweh said to Joshua, “Slip off your sandal from upon your foot, because the place that you are standing on, it {is} holy.” And Joshua did so.

title: Joshua 6:1
content: 1 Now Jericho {was} shutting and {was} being shut up from the face of the sons of Israel. There was no going out and there was no coming in.

title: Joshua 6:2
content: 2 And Yahweh said to Joshua, “See, I have given Jericho into your hand, and its king, the warriors of valor.

title: Joshua 6:3
content: 3 And you shall circle the city, all of the men of war, circling the city one time. Thus you shall do six days.

title: Joshua 6:4
content: 4 And seven priests shall carry seven shofars of rams to the face of the Box. And on the seventh day you shall circle the city seven times, and the priests shall blow on the shofars.

title: Joshua 6:5
content: 5 And it will happen, when they make a long blast with the horn of the ram, as soon as you hear the sound of the shofar, all of the people shall shout a great shout. And the wall of the city will fall under itself and the people shall go up, a man in front of him.”

title: Joshua 6:6
content: 6 So Joshua, the son of Nun, called to the priests and said to them, “Carry the Box of the Covenant, and seven priests shall carry seven shofars of rams to the face of the Box of Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 6:7
content: 7 And he said to the people, “Pass over and circle the city, and the armed {ones} will pass over to the face of the Box of Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 6:8
content: 8 And it happened, when Joshua had spoken to the people, that seven priests carrying seven shofars of rams to the face of Yahweh passed over and blew on the shofars. And the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh was going behind them.

title: Joshua 6:9
content: 9 And the armed {ones} {were} walking to the face of the priests blowing the shofars. And the rearguard {was} walking behind the Box, walking and blowing on the shofars.

title: Joshua 6:10
content: 10 And Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout, and you shall not make your voice heard, and a word shall not go out from your mouth until the day I say to you, ‘Shout!’ Then you shall shout.”

title: Joshua 6:11
content: 11 And he made the Box of Yahweh circle the city, circling one time. Then they entered the camp, and they lodged in the camp.

title: Joshua 6:12
content: 12 And Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests carried the Box of Yahweh.

title: Joshua 6:13
content: 13 And the seven priests carrying the seven shofars of rams to the face of the Box of Yahweh walking, {were} walking, and they blew on the shofars. And the armed {ones} {were} walking to their faces, and the rearguard {was} walking behind the Box of Yahweh, walking and blowing on the shofars.

title: Joshua 6:14
content: 14 And they circled the city one time on the second day, and they returned {to} the camp. Thus they did six days.

title: Joshua 6:15
content: 15 And it happened on the seventh day that they got up early, as soon as the dawn had risen, and they circled the city according to this manner seven times. Only on that day they circled the city seven times.

title: Joshua 6:16
content: 16 And it happened that on the seventh time, the priests blew on the shofars. And Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given the city to you!

title: Joshua 6:17
content: 17 And the city is a devoted thing, it and all that {is} in it, for Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute will live, she and all who {are} with her in the house, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.

title: Joshua 6:18
content: 18 But only you, keep yourselves from a devoted thing, lest you are devoting and you take from the devoted thing and you make the camp of Israel into a devoted thing and trouble it.

title: Joshua 6:19
content: 19 And all of the silver and gold and objects of bronze and iron, it is a holy thing for Yahweh. It shall enter the storehouse of Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 6:20
content: 20 And the people shouted, and they blew on the shofars. And it happened, when the people heard the sound of the shofar and the people shouted a great shout, that the wall fell under itself, and the people went up to the city, a man in front of him, and they captured the city.

title: Joshua 6:21
content: 21 And they devoted all that {was} in the city, from man and to woman, from young and to old, and to ox and sheep and donkey, to the mouth of the sword.

title: Joshua 6:22
content: 22 And Joshua said to the two men having spied out the land, “Enter the house of the woman, the prostitute, and bring out from there the woman and all who {are} to her, just as you swore to her.”

title: Joshua 6:23
content: 23 And the young men having spied entered and brought out Rahab and her father and her mother and her brothers and all who {were} to her. And they brought out all of her relatives and put them outside the camp of Israel.

title: Joshua 6:24
content: 24 And they burned with fire the city and all that {was} in it. Only the silver and the gold and the objects of bronze and iron, they put {in} the storehouse of the house of Yahweh.

title: Joshua 6:25
content: 25 And Joshua kept alive Rahab the prostitute and the house of her father and all who {were} to her. And she has dwelt in the midst of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua had sent to spy on Jericho.

title: Joshua 6:26
content: 26 And Joshua made {them} swear at that time, saying, “Cursed {is} the man to the face of Yahweh who arises and builds this city, Jericho. With his firstborn he will found it, and with his youngest he will set up its gates.”

title: Joshua 6:27
content: 27 And Yahweh was with Joshua, and the report of him was in all of the land.

title: Joshua 7:1
content: 1 But the sons of Israel treacherously committed a treacherous act regarding a devoted thing. For Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, took from the devoted thing. And the nose of Yahweh burned against the sons of Israel.

title: Joshua 7:2
content: 2 Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which {was} near Beth Aven, from the east of Bethel. And he spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy on the land.” And the men went up and spied on Ai.

title: Joshua 7:3
content: 3 And they returned to Joshua and said to him, “Do not let all the people go up. About 2, 000 men or about 3, 000 men should go up and strike Ai. Do not make all the people weary there, because they are few.”

title: Joshua 7:4
content: 4 And about 3, 000 men from the people went up there, and they fled to the face of the men of Ai.

title: Joshua 7:5
content: 5 And the men of Ai struck down from them about 36 men. And they pursued them from the face of the gate unto the quarries, and they struck them on the slope. And the heart of the people melted and became water.

title: Joshua 7:6
content: 6 And Joshua tore his garments and fell on his face to the earth to the face of the Box of Yahweh until the evening, he and the elders of Israel. And they made dust go up onto their heads.

title: Joshua 7:7
content: 7 And Joshua said, “Alas, my Lord Yahweh! Why, bringing across, did you bring this people across the Jordan to give us into the hand of the Amorite, to make us perish? And if only we had been content and had stayed on the other side of the Jordan!

title: Joshua 7:8
content: 8 Please, my Lord! What shall I say, now that Israel has turned the back of the neck to the face of its enemies?

title: Joshua 7:9
content: 9 And the Canaanite and all the dwellers of the land will hear, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the earth. And what will you do for your great name?”

title: Joshua 7:10
content: 10 And Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get yourself up! Why is this, you {are} falling on your face?

title: Joshua 7:11
content: 11 Israel has sinned and indeed transgressed my covenant, which I commanded them, and has indeed taken from the devoted thing and has indeed stolen and also deceived and also placed {it} among their things.

title: Joshua 7:12
content: 12 So the sons of Israel were not able to stand to the face of their enemies. They turned the back of the neck to the face of their enemies because they have become a devoted thing. I will not resume to be with you if you do not destroy the devoted thing from your midst.

title: Joshua 7:13
content: 13 Arise! Consecrate the people and say, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, because thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “A devoted thing is in your midst, Israel. You will not be able to stand to the face of your enemies until you remove the devoted thing from your midst.”

title: Joshua 7:14
content: 14 And you shall be brought near in the morning by your tribes. And it will happen, the tribe that Yahweh takes shall come near by clans, and the clan that Yahweh takes shall come near by houses, and the house that Yahweh takes shall come near by men.

title: Joshua 7:15
content: 15 And it will happen, the one taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that {is} to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of Yahweh, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

title: Joshua 7:16
content: 16 And Joshua got up early in the morning and brought Israel near by its tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.

title: Joshua 7:17

title: Joshua 22:1

content: 15 And they came into the land of Gilead to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to half of the tribe of Manasseh, and they spoke with them, saying,

But against Yahweh do not rebel, and against us do not rebel, by your building an altar for yourselves apart from the altar of Yahweh our God.

content: 20 {Did} not Achan, the son of Zerah, act unfaithfully in unfaithfulness with the devoted thing, and wrath was on all of the congregation of Israel? And he did not perish, one man, in his iniquity!’”

title: Joshua 22:21
content: 21 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke with the heads of the thousands of Israel:

title: Joshua 22:22

title: Joshua 22:23
content: 23 To build an altar for ourselves to turn from after Yahweh, or if to offer on it burnt offerings or grain offerings, or if to make on it sacrifices of peace offerings, Yahweh himself will seek.

title: Joshua 22:26
content: 26 So we said, ‘Let us now do to build for ourselves an altar, not for a burnt offering and not for a sacrifice,

title: Joshua 22:27
content: 27 but it {will be} a witness between us and between you and between our generations after us, to serve the service of Yahweh to his face with our burnt offerings and with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings. content: 28 And we said, ‘And it will happen, if they speak to us, or to our generations tomorrow, that we will say, “See, a copy of the altar of Yahweh that our fathers made, not for a burnt offering and not for a sacrifice, but it {is} a witness between us and between you.”

title: Joshua 22:30
content: 30 And Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the congregation and the heads of the thousands of Israel who {were} with him heard the words that the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the sons of Manasseh spoke. And it was good in their eyes.

title: Joshua 22:31
content: 31 And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the priest, said to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh {is} in the midst of us, that you have not acted unfaithfully in this unfaithfulness against Yahweh. Therefore, you have delivered the sons of Israel from the hand of Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 22:32
content: 32 And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, and the leaders returned from with the sons of Reuben and from with the sons of Gad, from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel. And they brought them a word.

title: Joshua 22:33

content: 4 See, I have caused to fall for you these remaining nations as an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, and all of the nations that I cut off, and the Great Sea from the going of the sun.

title: Joshua 23:5
content: 5 And Yahweh your God, he will push them from your face, and he will dispossess them from to your face. And you will possess their land, just as Yahweh your God has spoken to you.

title: Joshua 23:6
content: 6 And you shall be very strong to keep and to do everything written in the book of the instruction of Moses, not to turn aside from it right or left,

title: Joshua 23:7
content: 7 not to come among these nations, these ones remaining with you. And by the name of their gods you shall not invoke and you shall not swear, and you shall not serve them and you shall not bow down to them.

title: Joshua 23:8
content: 8 If not to Yahweh your God you shall cling, just as you have done to this day.

title: Joshua 23:9
content: 9 And Yahweh has dispossessed great and powerful nations from your faces. And you, a man has not stood against your faces to this day.

title: Joshua 23:10
content: 10 One man from you pursues a thousand, for Yahweh your God, he is the one fighting for you, just as he has spoken to you.

title: Joshua 23:11
content: 11 And you shall keep yourselves exceedingly to yourselves, to love Yahweh your God.

title: Joshua 23:12
content: 12 For if turning, you turn and cling to the remnant of these nations, these ones remaining with you, and you intermarry with them and you go among them and they among you,

title: Joshua 23:13
content: 13 knowing, may you know that Yahweh your God will not continue to dispossess these nations from to your face. And they will be to you for a snare and for a trap and for a whip on your sides and for thorns in your eyes, until you perish from upon this good ground that Yahweh your God has given to you.

title: Joshua 23:14
content: 14 And behold, today I myself am going in the way of all of the earth. And you know with all of your heart and with all of your soul that not one word has fallen from all of the good words that Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. The whole has come to you. Not one word has fallen from it.

title: Joshua 23:15
content: 15 And it will happen, just as all of the good word that Yahweh your God spoke to you has come upon you, thus Yahweh will bring upon you all of the evil word until he has destroyed you from upon this good ground that Yahweh your God has given to you.

title: Joshua 23:16
content: 16 In your transgressing the covenant of Yahweh your God that he commanded you and you go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the nose of Yahweh will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from upon the good land that he has given to you.”

title: Joshua 24:1
content: 1 And Joshua gathered all of the tribes of Israel to Shechem. And he called to the elders of Israel and to its heads and to its judges and to its officers. And they presented themselves to the face of God.

title: Joshua 24:2
content: 2 And Joshua said to all of the people, “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: ‘Your fathers dwelled from long ago beyond the river, Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor. And they served other gods.

title: Joshua 24:3
content: 3 And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river and brought him into all of the land of Canaan. And I multiplied his seed and gave to him Isaac.

title: Joshua 24:4
content: 4 And I gave Jacob and Esau to Isaac, and I gave to Esau the hill country of Seir to possess it, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

title: Joshua 24:5
content: 5 And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I struck Egypt according to what I did in the midst of it. And afterward I brought you out.

title: Joshua 24:6
content: 6 And I brought your fathers out from Egypt, and you came to the sea. And Egypt chased after your fathers with chariot and horsemen to the Sea of Reeds.

title: Joshua 24:7
content: 7 And they cried out to Yahweh, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and he brought the sea over him and covered him. And your eyes saw what I did against Egypt. And you dwelled in the wilderness many days.

title: Joshua 24:8
content: 8 And I brought you to the land of the Amorite, the ones dwelling on the other side of the Jordan, and they fought with you. And I gave them into your hand, and you possessed their land, and I destroyed them from your faces.

title: Joshua 24:9
content: 9 And Balak, the son of Zippor, the king of Moab, arose and fought with Israel. And he sent and called for Balaam, the son of Beor, to curse you.

title: Joshua 24:10
content: 10 But I was not willing to listen to Balaam. And blessing, he blessed you, and I delivered you from his hand.

title: Joshua 24:11
content: 11 And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. And the men of Jericho fought with you, the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Girgashite and the Hivite and the Jebusite. And I gave them into your hand.

title: Joshua 24:12
content: 12 And I sent the hornet to your faces, and it dispossessed them out from your faces, the two kings of the Amorite, not by your sword and not by your bow.

title: Joshua 24:13
content: 13 And I gave to you a land for which you had not labored and cities that you had not built, and you dwelled in them. You {are} eating vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

title: Joshua 24:14
content: 14 And now, you shall fear Yahweh and serve him with sincerity and with faithfulness. And you shall remove the gods that your fathers served beyond the river and in Egypt, and you shall serve Yahweh.

title: Joshua 24:15
content: 15 But if {it is} evil in your eyes to serve Yahweh, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve, whether the gods that your fathers served that were beyond the river or the gods of the Amorite in whose land you {are} dwelling. But I and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 24:16
content: 16 And the people answered and said, “Profane to us from leaving Yahweh to serve other gods!

title: Joshua 24:17
content: 17 For Yahweh, he {is} our God, the one having brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves, and who did these great signs before our eyes. And he kept us in all of the way in which we went and among all the peoples in whose midst we passed.

title: Joshua 24:18
content: 18 And Yahweh dispossessed from our faces all of the peoples and the Amorite, the dweller {in} the land. We ourselves will serve Yahweh, for he {is} our God.”

title: Joshua 24:19
content: 19 And Joshua said to the people, “You will not be able to serve Yahweh, for he {is} a holy God, he {is} a jealous God. He will not lift your transgressions and your sins.

title: Joshua 24:20
content: 20 If you forsake Yahweh and serve the gods of the foreigner, then he will turn and do harm to you and finish you, after when he has done good to you.”

title: Joshua 24:21
content: 21 And the people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

title: Joshua 24:22
content: 22 And Joshua said to the people, “You {are} witnesses against yourselves that you yourselves have chosen Yahweh for yourselves, to serve him.” And they said, “Witnesses.”

title: Joshua 24:23
content: 23 “And now, remove the gods of the foreigner that are in your midst, and stretch out your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

title: Joshua 24:24
content: 24 And the people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

title: Joshua 24:25
content: 25 And Joshua cut a covenant for the people on that day. And he set for them a statute and a judgment in Shechem.

title: Joshua 24:26
content: 26 And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the instruction of God. And he took a great stone and set it up there beneath the oak tree that {was} at the Holy Place of Yahweh.

title: Joshua 24:27
content: 27 And Joshua said to all of the people, “Behold, this stone will be for a witness against us, for it has heard all of the words of Yahweh that he spoke to us. And it will be for a witness against you, lest you deal falsely with your God.”

title: Joshua 24:28
content: 28 And Joshua sent the people away, a man to his inheritance.

title: Joshua 24:29
content: 29 And it happened after these things that Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, a son of 110 years.

title: Joshua 24:30
content: 30 And they buried him in the border of his inheritance, in Timnath Serah, which {is} in the hill country of Ephraim, from the north to Mount Gaash.

title: Joshua 24:31
content: 31 And Israel served Yahweh all of the days of Joshua and all of the days of the elders who lengthened days after Joshua and who knew every deed of Yahweh that he had done for Israel.

title: Joshua 24:32
content: 32 And the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel had brought up from Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in the portion of the field that Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for 100 qesitah. And it was to the sons of Joseph for an inheritance.

title: Joshua 24:33
content: 33 And Eleazar, the son of Aaron, died. And they buried him in Gibeah of Phinehas his son, which had been given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.
